lead: Monday belonged to Meta's Muse, for better and worse: [a zero-day let any local app seize the user's Muse account token](../summaries/16444d7e895b.md) just as [Shopify moved to let Muse complete purchases through Shop Pay](../summaries/69da42e0e50b.md). [British Columbia sued OpenAI](../summaries/a076342fd0a7.md) for failing to flag the Tumbler Ridge suspect's ChatGPT activity to police. Alibaba dominated infrastructure with [a plan for a 5-10T parameter model](../summaries/e562c5be6182.md) and [the Zhenwu V900 accelerator](../summaries/d405036f6769.md), while [Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro became the top-scoring open-weight model](../summaries/cba40109d163.md) on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index.
